evidence.scenario: Score convention matches (1+cos)/2 scale used by Postgres and Elasticsearch
evidence: REDIS-EVALUATION.md § Stream R3, Test 6: Score conversion verified
Formula: d = 1 − c (cosine distance); score = 1 − d/2 = (1+c)/2
Test case: c=0.8 → d=0.2 → score=0.9 ✅ matches (1+0.8)/2=0.9
100 random pairs tested; maximum deviation < 1e-6 ✅
REDIS-EVALUATION.md § Stream R3, Test 7 & Memory measurements table:
1k vectors: 2.3 MB (2,300 bytes/vector)
10k vectors: 23.1 MB (2,310 bytes/vector)
Linear scaling confirmed
36k vectors extrapolated: ~83 MB + overhead → ~95 MB recommended
